translations.name: Same-day emergency help at your County Social Service Agency
translations.description: If you have no food, shelter, utilities or clothing, your County Social Service Agency (formerly called the County Board of Social Services) must give you emergency help the same day you apply if you meet WFNJ requirements. If you are homeless or about to lose your housing, they must take your application right away. This is a legal right under WFNJ. Walk into your County Social Service Agency and say you are in immediate need. If they refuse, call Legal Services of NJ at 1-888-576-5529.
translations.warning: The regular Emergency Assistance program takes documents and time. This is the same-day help inside it.
translations.website_description: Learn about housing and utility help.
